comparison.objective: Peel a cucumber while leaving its ends intact; the candidate adjusts and locks industrial gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous blade control over curved produce with bimanual holding and damage avoidance, not threaded tool seating.
comparison.success_condition: Peel coverage and preservation of the ends/usable cucumber determine success; candidate measures angular retention and locking.
comparison.reason: Cutting/peeling and damage control are unrelated to stop-screw adjustment in both versions.
